items.text: The Rosary is the most beautiful and the most rich in graces of all prayers; it is the prayer that touches most the Heart of the Mother of God.
items.author: St. Pius X

items.text: Give me an army saying the Rosary and I will conquer the world.
items.author: Bl. Pius IX

items.text: The Rosary is a powerful weapon to put the demons to flight.
items.author: St. Padre Pio

items.text: Never will anyone who says his Rosary every day be led astray.
items.author: Bl. Alan de la Roche

items.text: The Rosary is the scourge of the devil.
items.author: Pope Adrian VI

items.text: Say the Rosary every day to obtain peace for the world.
items.author: Our Lady of Fatima

items.text: The holy Rosary is the storehouse of countless blessings.
items.author: Bl. Alan de la Roche

items.text: There is no problem, I tell you, no matter how difficult it is, that we cannot resolve by the prayer of the Holy Rosary.
items.author: Sr. Lucia of Fatima

items.text: I am the Lady of the Rosary. Continue to pray the Rosary every day.
items.author: Our Lady of Fatima

items.text: When the Rosary is said well, it gives Jesus and Mary more glory and is more meritorious than any other prayer.
items.author: St. Louis de Montfort

items.text: If you say the Rosary faithfully until death, I do assure you that you shall receive a never-fading crown of glory.
items.author: St. Louis de Montfort

items.text: Recite your Rosary with faith, with humility, with confidence, and with perseverance.
items.author: St. Louis de Montfort

items.text: Love the Madonna and pray the Rosary, for her Rosary is the weapon against the evils of the world today.
items.author: St. Padre Pio

items.text: The Rosary is the weapon for these times.
items.author: St. Padre Pio

items.text: Blessed be that monotony of Hail Marys which purifies the monotony of your sins.
items.author: St. Josemaría Escrivá

items.text: The Holy Rosary is a powerful weapon. Use it with confidence and you will be amazed at the results.
items.author: St. Josemaría Escrivá

items.text: The Rosary is the book of the blind, where souls see and there enact the greatest drama of love the world has ever known.
items.author: Ven. Fulton J. Sheen

items.text: The greatest method of praying is to pray the Rosary.
items.author: St. Francis de Sales

items.text: Among all the devotions approved by the Church, none has been so favored by so many miracles as the devotion of the Most Holy Rosary.
items.author: Bl. Pius IX

items.text: The Rosary is the most excellent form of prayer and the most efficacious means of attaining eternal life.
items.author: Pope Leo XIII

items.text: The family that prays together stays together.
items.author: Ven. Patrick Peyton
